# Decision Records (DR)

> A guide to decision records: a way to initiate, debate, and archive an important choice, along with its context and consequences, for any part of an organization. Includes a tutorial, templates, worked examples, and checklists. Source: https://github.com/decision-records/decision-records

## Guide

- [Guide: Decision Records for Leaders](https://decision-records.github.io/en-us/guide/)

## Tutorial

- [Tutorial: Write Your First Decision Record](https://decision-records.github.io/en-us/tutorial/)

## Template

- [Decision record templates](https://decision-records.github.io/en-us/template/)
